contentText: A banking crisis that saw the president of Paraguay impeached Friday, November 6, continues to rock the country with protesters back on the streets. The Ueno Bank started as a digital first bank, attracting many low income customers, quickly growing to become a major bank in charge of state pensions and holding the accounts of several government institutions before having its accounts frozen by the central bank due to solvency concerns.
